title: Blosc2
description: Python wrapper for Blosc2, a high-performance compressor optimized for binary data. Supports multidimensional arrays, lazy evaluation, and a compute engine for out-of-core processing.

title: archetypes
description: Scikit-learn-compatible Python library implementing archetypal analysis — a matrix factorization technique that represents data as convex combinations of extreme points (archetypes).

title: arkhety
description: Side project built on top of archetypal analysis, offering an interactive web application for exploring and visualizing archetypes in data.
